# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: CBD CRC DESeq2 directional gene lists
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$count_col <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c('DMSO', 'CBD_IC50')
layout2 <- layout[keep, , drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(layout2) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(layout2$count_col %in% colnames(counts))) stop('Some selected samples are absent from count matrix')
counts2 <- as.matrix(counts[, layout2$count_col, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(counts2) <- 'integer'
colnames(counts2) <- layout2$SampleID
rownames(layout2) <- layout2$SampleID
layout2$Group <- factor(layout2$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts2, colData=layout2[, c('Group'), drop=FALSE], design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c('gene_id','baseMean','log2FoldChange','lfcSE','stat','pvalue','padj')]
write.table(out, file='deseq2_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
sig <- out[!is.na(out$padj) & out$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, , drop=FALSE]
up <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange > 0, 'gene_id']
down <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange < 0, 'gene_id']
universe <- out[!is.na(out$padj), 'gene_id']
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
metrics <- data.frame(metric=c('contrast','tested_genes_with_non_na_padj','significant_up','significant_down'), value=c('CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO', length(universe), length(up), length(down)))
write.table(metrics, file='de_metrics.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq2.R '$(inputs.counts.path)' '$(inputs.layout.path)'

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

layout_path <- args[[2]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$count_col <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c('DMSO', 'CBD_IC50')
layout2 <- layout[keep, , drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(layout2) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(layout2$count_col %in% colnames(counts))) stop('Some selected samples are absent from count matrix')
counts2 <- as.matrix(counts[, layout2$count_col, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(counts2) <- 'integer'
colnames(counts2) <- layout2$SampleID
rownames(layout2) <- layout2$SampleID
layout2$Group <- factor(layout2$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts2, colData=layout2[, c('Group'), drop=FALSE], design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c('gene_id','baseMean','log2FoldChange','lfcSE','stat','pvalue','padj')]
write.table(out, file='deseq2_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
sig <- out[!is.na(out$padj) & out$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, , drop=FALSE]
up <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange > 0, 'gene_id']
down <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange < 0, 'gene_id']
universe <- out[!is.na(out$padj), 'gene_id']
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
metrics <- data.frame(metric=c('contrast','tested_genes_with_non_na_padj','significant_up','significant_down'), value=c('CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO', length(universe), length(up), length(down)))
write.table(metrics, file='de_metrics.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
